notices.support: Home improvement and service and repair contracts print the "Information about the Contractors State License Board (CSLB)" notice "in at least 12-point type"

notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of B&P 7030, which holds two different statements (the 10 point statement for other prime contracts and the 12 point notice for home improvement) plus the discipline rule; printing it would put the wrong statement and non-notice text in a home improvement contract.

notices.title: WARNING TO BUYER: putting up your home as security (door-to-door home improvement contract secured by a lien on real property)
notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale of home improvement goods or services in a contract that contains or is secured by a lien on real property
notices.format: 18 point boldface, separate piece of paper, signed and dated by the buyer, same language as the contract, signed copy handed over at signing
notices.support: the contract shall be accompanied by the following notice in 18-point boldfaced type
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door home improvement contract secured by a lien on the home: 18 point WARNING TO BUYER
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of B&P 7159.1, including the exemptions and the rule that a security interest without the notice is void, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; also whether a lien secures the contract is not known to the builder.

notices.title: ARBITRATION OF DISPUTES title and NOTICE before the initials line
notices.trigger: Contract for work on residential property with four or fewer units that contains an arbitration clause
notices.format: Clause titled ARBITRATION OF DISPUTES; 10 point roman boldface (or red 8 point boldface), capitals if typed; the NOTICE sits immediately before and after the initials line
notices.support: the provision shall be clearly titled
notices.summary_row: Arbitration clause title and NOTICE (residential, four or fewer units)
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of B&P 7191, including the enforceability rule and the board's discipline authority, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; the notice is also only needed when the contract has an arbitration clause.

notices.title: Home solicitation cancellation statement near the signature and Notice of Cancellation form (sales other than home improvement and service and repair contracts)
notices.trigger: Home solicitation sale of $25 or more made away from the seller's trade premises that is not a home improvement or service and repair contract (for example a recurring cleaning plan sold at the home)
notices.format: Statement at least 10 point boldface in immediate proximity to the buyer's signature; duplicate detachable Notice of Cancellation form, at least 10 point; same language as the sales presentation; oral notice
notices.support: shall contain in immediate proximity to the space reserved for the buyer
notices.summary_row: Home solicitation: statement near signature, first-page seller details, Notice of Cancellation form, oral notice
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of Civ. Code 1689.7, with several versions of the statement (senior, disaster, emergency response unit, home improvement) and other rules around them, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract.

notices.title: Service and repair contract notices ($750 or less)
notices.trigger: Service and repair contract of $750 or less that the customer asked for, with no payment before the work is done and nothing sold beyond the problem
notices.format: Several notices, 10 point boldface type notice and 12 point boldface notices signed and dated by the buyer

notices.summary_row: Service and repair contract ($750 or less): contents and notices
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of B&P 7159.10, which mixes the definition, the contract content rules and the notices, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; whether the customer asked for the work is not known to the builder.
